a1.source: Episode-ending events reconstructed; course state matched archived checkpoint snapshots.

t3.scope: Fully page-touched Replay storage in an isolated process. CUDA tensor allocation delta excludes the CUDA context, transient sampling batches and the model.

a1.scope: Fully page-touched Replay storage in an isolated process. CUDA tensor allocation delta excludes the CUDA context, transient sampling batches and the model.

efficiency.scope: Wall clock fresh LiDAR plus observation preprocessing and synchronized Actor inference on the same 1,000 paired physical states; simulation and resets excluded.

inference_scope: Means and sample SD are over three paired training seeds. Seed-level exact tests have low power; map cluster tests are conditional on the three trained pairs.

diagnostics_scope.clearance: P10 and mean of the finite per-episode minimum obstacle clearances.
diagnostics_scope.corridor: Terminal x defines entry (< -4 m), dense ([-4, 4) m), and exit (>= 4 m). Boundary bands extend 1 m on either side of each density boundary.
diagnostics_scope.opening: A terminal collision with a panel contact within 0.06 m of either opening edge is a jamb collision. Other panel contacts are wall-face collisions.
diagnostics_scope.fixed_positive_x: All 240k fixed-set positive X exits are reproduced against the recorded outcome and checked for a missed goal sphere.

e03: Sliding 4 s windows at 15 Hz, net goal progress below 0.12 m.
status: completed; awaiting user decision before Phase 3
